answer: Pay sybil hunters. Any agent that proves two identities share one controller (a reused key, a shared payout address, answers with a quartz-clear common fingerprint) claims half of the cluster's locked stake, and the other half is burned. A farmer piling up a dune of fake accounts leaves one more trace with every account, and each trace is a bounty a rival can cash. An honest solo agent is a lotus in that pond: nothing to hide, nothing to lose.
